title: Defining Exact Data Match Fields for Custom DLP Dictionaries

blocks.text: You can add Exact Data Match (EDM) index templates and fields to custom DLP dictionaries that represent content you want to protect in your organization. To learn more, see Adding Custom DLP Dictionaries.
Before you can add EDM fields to a custom dictionary, you must create and submit an EDM index template that defines your data. To learn more, see Creating an Exact Data Match Template.
You can configure EDM to function without primary or secondary fields, without primary keys, or to scan for popular formats. To learn more, see Configuring DLP Advanced Settings.
To add Exact Data Match templates and fields:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > Common Resources > Dictionaries & Engines.
Select the DLP Dictionaries tab.
On the DLP Dictionaries tab, click Add DLP Dictionary or click the Edit icon for an existing dictionary.
The Add/Edit DLP Dictionary page appears.
On the Add/Edit DLP Dictionary page:
Dictionary Type: Select Exact Data Match.
Data Template: From the drop-down menu, select the EDM template you want to use for the dictionary.
See image.
Primary Field: Select a primary field you want the dictionary to match against when scanning content.
See image.
Secondary Fields: Select any secondary fields you want the dictionary to match against when scanning content, if the dictionary detects a valid match for the primary field.
See image.

The drop-down menu lists all the other data fields that were defined for the EDM template. If more than one primary field was defined, but was not selected in the previous step, it will appear as a secondary field option.
See image.
Secondary Match On: Select one of the following options from the drop-down menu:
None: The dictionary only needs to match against the primary field; no secondary fields are validated.
At Least 1 Field: The dictionary needs to match against the primary field and at least one secondary field.
At Least 2 Fields: The dictionary needs to match against the primary field and at least two secondary fields.
All Fields: The dictionary needs to match against the primary field and all secondary fields.
See image.
(Optional) If you want to apply fields from another EDM template to this dictionary, click Add Template and repeat the previous steps.
Click Save and activate the change.
